RHEOGRAPH 20 / 25 / 75 / 120
Product catalog summary
Technical Highlights:
Available in single, twin, or triple barrel systems with sizes ranging from 9.55 mm to 30 mm.
Speed range from 0.00004 to 40 mm/s, with high dynamic acceleration capabilities.
Temperature range up to 400°C, optionally 500°C, with high-resolution display.
Automatic pressure transducer detection and adaptive signal processing.
System Overview:
The RHEOGRAPH series, including models 20, 25, 50, 75, and 120, are designed for high-pressure capillary rheometry with advanced automation and user-friendly features. They are equipped with CAN-Bus technology and are suitable for a wide range of applications in research, development, and quality assurance.
Performance Improvements:
Enhanced pressure measurement accuracy, improving by a factor of 10.
Expanded measurement range, especially at lower shear rates.
Improved repeatability and reduced need for multiple test runs.
Special Features:
Detection of flow instabilities (Shark-Skin effect) with advanced sensors and software.
Thermal conductivity measurement up to 450°C and 1000 bar.
PVT (Pressure-Volume-Temperature) measurements according to ISO 17744.
Die swell measurement and pressure dependence of viscosity analysis.
Software and Evaluation:
Network-capable software system for parameterization and evaluation.
Includes Microsoft ACCESS database and various evaluation tools.
Supports calculations and corrections for different capillary models.
Options and Accessories:
Various barrel geometries and force ranges available.
Additional options like melt cutting units, external tempering, and more.
Contact Information:
GÖTTFERT Werkstoff-Prüfmaschinen GmbH, Germany; GOETTFERT Inc., USA; GOETTFERT - Dataphysics Instruments India Pvt. Ltd., India; GOETTFERT (China) Limited, China.
